name: g_global
description: First-phase rate
source: IEA "Energy and AI" (2025), data-centre electricity about 415 TWh in 2024, about 945 TWh in 2030, about 1,200 TWh in 2035 (base case); LBNL-2001637 as quoted by Li et al. (US on-site water could be 2-4x the 2023 level by 2028); Xylem and Global Water Intelligence, "Watering the New Economy" (Jan 2026, AI value-chain water +129% by 2050, a different scope)
notes: Range chosen from these projections; the mode is a judgment, not a measured value; read from secondary coverage and to be checked against the primary reports; no source covers 2035-2077, which is most of the horizon.

name: W_indirect_us

source: LBNL, 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report

name: g_us
description: US data center water use first-phase annual growth rate
source: LBNL, 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report
notes: First-phase evidence anchor: LBNL 2024 as quoted by Li et al. says US data-center on-site consumption in 2028 could be 2-4 times 2023. Xylem and GWI Watering the New Economy January 2026 reports AI value-chain demand up 129% by 2050 including power and chips; a different scope. Reserved: no runnable scenario uses US growth rows.

name: G_us
description: Years US data center first-phase growth continues before second phase
notes: First-phase duration is PLACEHOLDER. Evidence anchors for review: LBNL 2024 as quoted by Li et al. says US data-center on-site consumption in 2028 could be 2-4 times 2023; Xylem and GWI Watering the New Economy January 2026 reports AI value-chain demand up 129% by 2050 including power and chips; a different scope. Reserved: no runnable scenario uses US growth rows.

name: g2_us
